game.abil.shoot.name: Shoot
game.abil.aimed.name: Aimed Shot
game.abil.aimed.desc: Aim +20, Damage +1 (only if you haven't moved)
game.abil.suppress.name: Suppressing Fire
game.abil.suppress.desc: Uses 2 rounds. Target's Aim −30; fires again if the target moves
game.abil.grenade.name: Grenade
game.abil.firstaid.name: First Aid
game.abil.overwatch.name: Overwatch
game.abil.overwatch.desc: Fires at enemies that move in sight (Aim −10)
game.abil.hunker.name: Hunker Down
game.abil.reload.name: Reload
game.abil.mortar.name: Mortar
game.abil.mortar.desc: Shell anywhere in squad sight. Shells are shared by the squad
game.abil.heavy.name: Heavy MG
game.abil.heavy.desc: Fire the emplaced heavy machine gun (Aim +15)
game.abil.ambush.name: Rathole Ambush
game.abil.ambush.desc: Hide beside cover. Cats can't see you until you fire
game.abil.warcry.name: War Squeak
game.abil.warcry.desc: Allies within 4 tiles: Aim +10 this turn, Stress −10 (once per battle)
game.abil.charge.name: Demo Charge
game.abil.charge.desc: Blows away adjacent cover · walls · even truck wrecks
game.abil.tunnel.name: Dig Tunnel
game.abil.tunnel.desc: Links your tile to a chosen tile by tunnel. Any ally can use either entrance, and moving through costs no mobility (once per battle)
game.abil.flame.name: Flamethrower
game.abil.flame.desc: Flames ignore cover and burn next turn. Also burns away low cover
game.abil.knife.name: Knife
game.abil.knife.desc: Stab an adjacent enemy (Aim +30). Makes no sound
game.abil.mark.name: Mark Target
game.abil.mark.desc: Allies get Aim +15 against that enemy for the rest of the battle
game.abil.command.name: Rat Runner
game.abil.command.desc: One ally in sight gets AP +1
game.abil.dominate.name: Mind Control
game.abil.dominate.desc: Control one enemy as an ally for 2 turns (Psi 2)
game.abil.barrage.name: Spray Fire
game.abil.barrage.desc: Shoots every enemy in a cone (length 7 · width 3) toward the chosen target (Aim −15). Destroys low cover and empties the clip
game.abil.trap.name: Booby Trap
game.abil.trap.desc: Set a trap that blows when a cat steps on it. Cats can't see it
game.abil.smoke.name: Smoke Grenade
game.abil.smoke.desc: Smoke for 2 turns. Shots into or through it get Aim −30; units inside can't be seen beyond 3 tiles
game.abil.dash.name: Shadow Dash
game.abil.dash.desc: Rush an enemy within 5 tiles and stab at once. Still draws overwatch fire on the way
game.abil.painkiller.name: Painkiller
game.abil.painkiller.desc: Self or adjacent ally. Ignore arm · leg wounds this battle, Stress −10 (+10 when it ends). Uses 1 medkit
game.abil.supply.name: Supply Run
game.abil.supply.desc: All allies within 4 tiles get HP +3. Uses 1 medkit
game.abil.flare.name: Flare
game.abil.flare.desc: Lights a 4-tile radius for 2 turns. Reveals cats in the fog
game.abil.artillery.name: Call Artillery
game.abil.artillery.desc: A shell lands there at the start of the next ally turn (1 mortar shell). The impact point is marked in advance
game.abil.terror.name: Whisper of Dread
game.abil.terror.desc: One cat can't act next turn (Psi 1)
game.abil.cannon.name: Tank Gun
game.abil.cannon.desc: One shell. Destroys even high cover
game.abil.cleanse.name: Mind Cleanse
game.abil.cleanse.desc: One ally's Stress −30; ends panic · berserk · flight (Psi 1)
game.class.trooper.name: Cat Rifleman
game.class.mgcat.name: Cat Machine Gunner
game.class.officer.name: Cat Officer
game.class.catsniper.name: Cat Sniper
game.class.catflame.name: Cat Flamer
game.class.catassault.name: Cat Assault Trooper
game.class.catgren.name: Cat Grenadier
game.class.catheavy.name: Armored Cat
game.class.cattank.name: Cat Tank
game.class.recruit.name: Rifleman
game.class.recruit.desc: A recruit whose path isn't set yet
game.class.sniper.name: Sniper
game.class.sniper.desc: Hides in a rathole and ends it with one shot from afar. Weak up close
game.class.gunner.name: Machine Gunner
game.class.gunner.desc: Bursts · suppression · spray fire. Lifts squad morale with a War Squeak
game.class.engineer.name: Sapper
game.class.engineer.desc: Blows down walls, digs tunnels, sets traps. Gnaws straight through barbed wire
game.class.commando.name: Commando
game.class.commando.desc: Climbs over walls, slips through smoke, and finishes it silently with a knife
game.class.medic.name: Medic
game.class.medic.desc: Brings downed comrades back and keeps the squad going with painkillers and supplies
game.class.scout.name: Scout
game.class.scout.desc: Senses enemies behind walls with whiskers, lights the dark with flares, and marks targets
game.class.radio.name: Radioman
game.class.radio.desc: Commands distant allies with Rat Runners and calls in artillery by radio
game.class.shaman.name: Shaman
game.class.shaman.desc: Seizes enemy minds or fills them with dread, and steadies allied hearts
game.diff.easy.name: Recruit
game.diff.easy.desc: Rat Aim +10 · Cat Aim −10 · Cat Crit −10 · Next shot Aim +10 after a miss · Cat hit streaks eased
game.diff.normal.name: Sergeant
game.diff.normal.desc: Base stats · Aim +5 on next shot after a miss · Cat hit streaks slightly eased
game.diff.hard.name: Sergeant Major
game.diff.hard.desc: Cat Aim +5 · Cat Crit +5 · No luck adjustments
game.diff.nightmare.name: Trench Nightmare
game.diff.nightmare.desc: Cat Aim +10 · Cat Crit +10 · No luck adjustments
game.perk.revive: First Aid gets a downed ally back on their feet (2 HP)
game.perk.ghost: Sleeping cat packs only wake when you're within 3 tiles
game.perk.flamer: Weapon becomes a flamethrower. Aim +15 · 4-tile cone of fire · 40% chance to explode when downed (instant death)
game.perk.weakspot: Marked enemies lose Dodge; allies get Crit +15
game.perk.gnawer: Entering barbed wire costs 1 extra mobility and gnaws through it
game.mission.m1.name: 1-1 · Sewer Exit
game.mission.m1.brief: Get out of the sewers and clear the cat outpost on the edge of town. First sortie. Move from cover to cover.
game.mission.m2.name: 1-2 · Mortar on the Hill
game.mission.m2.brief: Cross the farm, take the abandoned mortar pit on the hill, and drive the cat squad back to their trench line.
game.mission.m3.name: 1-3 · The Officer at the Station
game.mission.m3.brief: Break through the freight yard and kill the cat officer hiding in the village behind the station. Drop the officer and the rest will scatter.
game.mission.mb1.name: Act 1 Boss · Breaking the Line
game.mission.mb1.brief: Cross no man's land, break three lines of trenches, and bring down the tyrant cat officer in the command bunker. Seize the MG nest and you can sweep the second trench.
game.mission.m21.name: 2-1 · Trench Breakthrough (WIP)
game.mission.m21.brief: Break the trench line and get at least one rat to the flag in the ruined village. No need to kill them all.
game.mission.m22.name: 2-2 · The Chancellor's Guard (WIP)
game.mission.m22.brief: The Chancellor's own guard has locked down the station. Wipe them out to the last cat.
